pages.text: Slay the Elder Guardian, and the Maw will drink in the ancient horror's gills. Beneath the waves, you breathe as the drowned do, without fear of the dark below.
The deep ceases to resist you. The beast bends the current to its will, and you glide through the water with a hunter's swiftness.
Deed (Advanced): slay an Elder Guardian, with or without the Maw in hand. The gift is lost on any who carry no Maw.
